summary_en: Tokio Co. and Yuuki Co. to acquire 9,550,000 shares each (8.62% of voting rights each, 17.24% combined) from Phoenix Co. (current shareholder) on June 4, 2026. Acquisition meets thresholds triggering disclosure under Financial Instruments Exchange Act Article 167(1) as regulated large-block acquisition. Both acquirers intend long-term stable ownership.
title_en: Notice regarding block share acquisition (act equivalent to public tender offer as prescribed by ordinance)
translation_en_brief: Link and Motivation Inc. received notice on June 3, 2026, that Tokio Co. and Yuuki Co. have agreed to acquire shares from Phoenix Co., a current shareholder of the company. Tokio will acquire 9,550,000 shares (8.62% of voting rights) and Yuuki will acquire 9,550,000 shares (8.62% of voting rights), both on June 4, 2026. The combined acquisition of 19,100,000 shares represents 17.24% of voting rights and triggers disclosure obligations under the Financial Instruments Exchange Act Article 167(1) and Cabinet Office Ordinance Article 31 as a large-block acquisition act equivalent to a public tender offer. Both acquirers indicate their purpose is to hold the shares as stable long-term shareholders. The disclosure is made at the request of the acquirers pursuant to Cabinet Office Ordinance Article 30(1)(4).
